3. Against the aforesaid ex-parte order dated 12-12-81 passed by the Court of Assistant Judge, Chhatak, Sunamganj in Miscellaneous Case No. 197 of 1970 the husband of the petitioner filed a Miscellaneous Case No. 5 of 1982 which was subsequently renumbered as 69 of 1984 under Order 9, rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the ex parte order dated 12-12-81 but on a subsequent date the said Miscellaneous Case No.69 of 1984 was transferred to newly created upazila Chhatak. The said Misc. Case 69 of 1984 was also dismissed for default on 17-12-86. The opposite party No.1 subsequently filed an application under section 96(9)(c) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 on 15-2-90 for getting delivery of possession of the pre-empted land on the ground, amongst others, that the pre-emption case was allowed on 12-12-81 by ex parte order and after ex parte order there was a Miscellaneous Case under Order 9, rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure to set aside the ex parte order dated 12-12-81 but the same was also dismissed for default on 17-2-86 and as such, the opposite party No. 1 herein prayed for recovery of khas possession of the pre-empted land. 

 4. The learned Assistant Judge, Chhatak received the said application on 15-2-90 and registered the same as Miscellaneous Case No. 6 of 1990 on 25-2-90. Thereafter the Assistant Judge by his order dated 25-2-90 directed the present petitioner to show cause as to why the said application should not be allowed. On 25-9-90 the petitioner herein appeared and filed written objection and contended, inter alia, that the Miscellaneous Case No. 6 of 1990 is not maintainable and the same is also barred by limitation. The learned Assistant Judge, Chhatak after hearing the parties and perusing the evidence on record was pleased to allow the said Miscellaneous Case No. 6 of 1990 by the impugned order dated 9-3-91 after condoning the delay under section 5 of the Limitation Act. In fact, the prayer for recovery of khas possession of the preempted land was allowed by order dated 9- 3-91.
